# Parse the old songs list
import re

content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " to separate title and artist(s)
        if ' by ' in song_str:
            title, artist = song_str.split(' by ', 1)
            old_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
        else:
            # No artist, just title
            old_songs.append((song_str.strip(), ''))
print(old_songs)
